Overview

A quick, easy beach break from Mumbai. Stay at a beach resort, tour the forts and beaches of North Goa, see the old churches and quiet beaches of the south, and try water sports at Calangute. Great for friends, couples and families.

Tour highlights

  • Beach resort with pool
  • North Goa: Fort Aguada, Calangute, Baga and Anjuna
  • South Goa: Old Goa churches, Colva and Palolem
  • Water sports at Calangute / Baga
  • Mandovi river cruise in the evening
  • Free evening for Goa's famous beach shacks
✈ Flights🏨 Beach Resort🚌 Transfers🏄 Watersports

Day-by-day itinerary

Day 1 Arrive in Goa

Fly from Mumbai to Goa (Dabolim or Mopa). Transfer to your beach resort. Evening at the beach.

Day 2 North Goa tour

Visit Fort Aguada, Sinquerim, Calangute, Baga, Anjuna and Chapora Fort (the "Dil Chahta Hai" fort). Water sports at Calangute.

  • Breakfast
Day 3 South Goa tour & river cruise

See the Basilica of Bom Jesus and Se Cathedral in Old Goa, Mangueshi Temple, Dona Paula and Miramar. Evening Mandovi river cruise with music and dance.

  • Breakfast
Day 4 Free day

Relax by the pool or the beach. Optional: Dudhsagar waterfall trip or a dolphin-spotting boat ride.

  • Breakfast
Day 5 Depart for Mumbai

Check out and transfer to the airport for your flight home.

  • Breakfast

Good to know

Best time to go: October to March. Monsoon (June–September) is green and cheap but water sports stop.

Frequently asked questions

Can we go by train or car instead of flight?

Yes. We can build the package around a train ticket or your own car and lower the price.

North Goa or South Goa — where should we stay?

North Goa is lively with more nightlife; South Goa is calmer and better for families and couples. We can split the stay too.
